middleware.scenario: 4 waves of 10 POST requests, each body 4 MiB, external application promise never settles, waitUntil deadline accelerated to 5 ms, forced GC after each wave
middleware.cause: expired Promise reactions retained scope closures; reaction child promises also inherited the request AsyncLocalStorage store

cacheRpc.scenario: 4 waves of 10 successful fresh-cache RPC reads with a request AbortSignal and 2 MiB request-local memo state, forced GC between waves before the 5-second RPC deadline
cacheRpc.cause: AbortSignal.timeout plus AbortSignal.any retained timers and their inherited request context until expiration even after successful RPC completion

verification.checks: After warming imports and isolating Undici connection ownership, all measured request bodies and stores are collectible. Covers native Promise, Promise subclass, late rejection, JSON-body deadline and parent cancellation.

limits: These are controlled retention diagnostics, not process RSS or throughput benchmarks. Initial module/connection references and application-owned promises may retain their own contexts. Node's allocator can keep freed memory reserved. No heap tuning, worker retirement changes or forced GC in production.
